notes: New: Music is now Media Player, and it plays local videos too, not just audio - browse and play video files already on your device the same way you already could with music, complete with thumbnails and a full video view. Auto EQ can now reach three more presets (Small Speakers, Treble Boost, Bass Boost) by analyzing the actual audio in real time, not just station/episode tags. Fixed: a real, wide-reaching bug where tapping a station, channel, episode, or track could silently do nothing the first time you played anything in a fresh app session - every screen was affected, now fixed for good. Local tracks and videos could stop playing shortly after starting, especially with repeat on - fixed a crash in the background recording pipeline. The search field's spoken label was silently missing for TalkBack users - now announced correctly. Plus a full accessibility pass across the app with verified TalkBack support everywhere.
